notes: SAP Labs has no separate careers domain: the ledger URL is SAP's own entry, which 301s to jobs.sap.com/en/jobs/ (Next.js, ?page=N, 412 jobs). Neither SAP listing publishes a SAP Labs employer/division facet (new site: Teams / Locations / Work Pattern / Contract Type; previous site: Work area / Career status / Country), so SAP Labs-titled roles are the subset of the shared SAP board whose titles carry the SAP Labs brand. Filter parameters are inert server-side, so filtering is local.
